parsed.summary: The patch addresses the issue but introduces a non-minimal change and potential maintainability issues.

issues.description: The patch introduces a non-minimal change by modifying the behavior of the function for all Function types, not just the specific case of exp().
The patch decreases maintainability by introducing a conditional check within the loop that processes function arguments, making the code harder to follow.
